svg.title: AzUrlShortener legacy Azure Static Web Apps and Functions architecture
svg.desc: Historical pre-migration Azure architecture. A Standard Azure Static Web App serves the Blazor WebAssembly admin and routes API requests through a linked Azure Functions backend. Short-link visitors call the same Function App directly for redirects. One Consumption Y1 Function App handles redirect, admin API, and scheduled timer functions, using Azure Storage Standard LRS for data and Functions runtime state. Classic Application Insights collects telemetry. This illustrates the legacy design, not current production status.
svg.text: The Static Web Apps + Functions approach
A Blazor WebAssembly admin, SWA-linked API, and redirects all shared one Azure Functions app.
Browser loads the Blazor WebAssembly app
Separate jobs · static-app token / publish profile
AZURE · LEGACY RESOURCE GROUP · REGION PER DEPLOYMENT
Blazor WebAssembly · MudBlazor · static hosting + CDN
Standard SKU enables linked Functions backend
.NET isolated · Functions v4 · Y1 Dynamic plan
Redirects · link management · click analytics · scheduler
Shared app settings, deployment, scale & failure boundary
Anonymous HTTP triggers rely on SWA front-door auth for admin
Classic Functions host and all functions deployed as one package
Standard LRS · account key / connection string
App data and runtime state use one account
ARM template generated this account; data retained across app changes
No workspace-based Log Analytics pair in legacy ARM
Shared plan under the single Function App
Historical design based on the legacy ARM template and Static Web Apps / Functions workflows. Resource names and live/decommissioned state are intentionally not asserted.
LEGACY REFERENCE · NOT THE CURRENT DEPLOYMENT MODEL
